entities.name: Kazakh National Medical University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Kazakh National Medical University is a university in Almaty, Kazakhstan. It was established in 1931, and the first rector was S.D. Asfendiyarov. In 2001, the government classified it as a "national" university.
